ticks.note: ABRO with signals. Tick 1: `A` and `B` are present but the transitions are delayed, so they are ignored.
`B`: `HandleB` finishes; the join fires and `O` is present.
`O` is a signal, so it is absent again; `A`, `B` are ignored now.
`A` and `B`: both finish in one tick, `O` present.
`A`, `B` and `R`: `R` resets ABRO again (strong abort out of `Done`). `A` and `B` in the reset tick are ignored because the re-entered transitions are delayed: `O` absent.
